# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Age:** Young man  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c25 P8](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Theology student and minister  <sub>[v1 c25 P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend Ez  <sub>[v1 c19 P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an extremely plain young man with a large, gangly frame and long, awkward legs. He has limp flaxen hair, green eyes, a wide mouth, and large ears. Despite his awkward appearance, his face lights up with a bright, earnest expression and he has a lovely voice when speaking.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P10](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0010), [v1 c25 P11](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0011), [v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015)_

## Personality

Ezra is an earnest, sincere, and dedicated minister with a deep spiritual nature. Despite his solemnity in the pulpit, he is cheerful, friendly, and enjoys laughing and joking in informal settings. He is humble, unpretentious, and deeply devoted to his faith and service, while also being somewhat diffident about his own financial standing.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 c25 P11](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0011), [v1 c25 P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)_

## Goals

- To serve as a dedicated Christian minister and help others  <sub>[v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- To marry Cressida Lindsay and build a life together  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## History

While studying theology at St. Columbia, Ezra Hale spent a summer serving as a student minister for the Point Prospect Mission Church. During his stay at Prospect Point, he met Cressida Lindsay, with whom he quickly formed a close and affectionate friendship. Although Cressida initially resisted his plain looks and lack of wealth, Ezra's sincerity and powerful preaching deeply impressed her. Following his graduation from St. Columbia, Ezra accepted a post managing a mission church in the Tanner Street slums. After a period of courtship, he proposed to Cressida, and the two were eventually married in June beneath a honeysuckle trellis at Echo Cottage.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 c25 P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v1 c29 P15](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0015), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P17](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0017)_
